headline: 880 children dead as measles outbreak hits Bangladesh
summary: Two more children died in the last 24 hours, with 979 new infections reported by the Directorate General of Health Services.
details: According to a report by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Tuesday, two children died within the last 24 hours due to measles symptoms.
In the same period, 979 children were reported to have been infected with measles or shown symptoms of the disease.
Since March 15, a total of 782 children have died showing measles symptoms, while 98 children have died from confirmed measles cases.
The total death toll from measles and measles-like symptoms across the country has now reached 880 children.

headline_marked: 756 [[fresh dengue cases reported]] overnight across Bangladesh
headline: 756 fresh dengue cases reported overnight across Bangladesh
summary: No deaths were recorded in the last 24 hours, but thousands have been hospitalized this year according to health officials.
details: According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 756 people were admitted to hospitals with dengue fever in the last 24 hours.
No deaths were reported during this period, but the surge in cases continues across various divisions.
The breakdown of new admissions includes 259 from Khulna, 110 from Dhaka North City Corporation, 106 from Dhaka South City Corporation, and 89 from Chattogram.
Other reported cases include 80 from Barishal, 63 from Rajshahi, 27 from Mymensingh, 17 from Rangpur, and 5 from Sylhet.
So far this year, a total of 20,827 people have been infected with dengue, with 61.7% being men and 38.3% being women.
The total number of dengue-related deaths in the country has reached 61 for the current year, according to the DGHS.
